remedy_rows.prescription_text: Adopt Jupiter-strengthening conduct: serve the significations of Jupiter (e.g. its karaka domain, its deity Brihaspati/Vishnu), avoid its signification-harming actions, and live per its dharma. Behavioral alignment is the deepest remedy — it changes the karma, not just the symptom.
Donate chana dal to the needy / a temple / a Brahmin on Thursday (for Jupiter propitiation). Consistent donation on the planet's day pacifies its afflictions.
Donate yellow gram (chana dal), turmeric, yellow cloth, or gold on Thursdays. Feed Brahmins or holy men. Donate to educational institutions.
remedy_rows.source_citation: BPHS (Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra), trans. Rishi Kumar Shastri, public domain

remedy_rows.prescription_text: Donate gold to the needy / a temple / a Brahmin on Thursday (for Jupiter propitiation). Consistent donation on the planet's day pacifies its afflictions.
Donate turmeric to the needy / a temple / a Brahmin on Thursday (for Jupiter propitiation). Consistent donation on the planet's day pacifies its afflictions.

Thursday dana for Jupiter (BPHS Ch.93): donate chana dal (yellow gram), turmeric, yellow cloth, and gold to a Brahmin or pandit on Thursdays, preferably during Guru Hora (Jupiter's planetary hour). Feed Brahmins or holy men sweets and yellow rice. BPHS Ch.93 specifically prescribes gold-and-yellow-gram as the Jupiter dana pair.

Watering the Ashwattha (Peepal tree, Ficus religiosa) on Thursdays and circumambulating it 108 times is prescribed for Jupiter strengthening in classical tradition. The Ashwattha is Jupiter's sacred tree (BPHS Ch.94 tree-correspondence table). This is a dana-in-kind — offering service to Jupiter's tree.
Donate sweets, yellow gram, turmeric, or gold to Brahmins on Thursdays for Jupiter-related liver and gallbladder issues. Jupiter governs the liver, fat, and growth.

remedy_rows.prescription_text: Wear a tested Yellow Sapphire (Pukhraj) in gold on the prescribed finger, on Thursday, during Shukla Paksha. ONLY if Jupiter is a functional benefic in the chart (test for 3 days first before committing).
Perform a Brihaspati/Vishnu / Jupiter graha-shanti homa (fire ritual) with the prescribed samidha (fire-wood) on Thursday. 1008 ahutis is the standard count for a full dasha-shanti.

Complete the Jupiter mantra japa to its mahadasha count over the dasha period: recite 'Om Graam Greem Graum Sah Gurave Namah' on Thursdays and daily. Standard counts: Sun 7,000; Moon 11,000; Mars 10,000; Mercury 9,000; Jupiter 19,000; Venus 16,000; Saturn 23,000; Rahu 18,000; Ketu 17,000.

For afflicted Jupiter (debilitated in Capricorn, Guru Chandal dosha, retrograde in dasha): recite Vishnu Sahasranama (Mahabharata, Anushasana Parva 149) once daily on Thursdays. Jupiter is the karaka of dharma and wisdom — Vishnu Sahasranama is the classical prescription for Guru-related obstacles per Phaladeepika's remedial section.
remedy_rows.source_citation: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), trans. G.S. Kapoor, public domain

remedy_rows.prescription_text: For birth in Purva Bhadrapada nakshatra: recite the nakshatra devata mantra 'Om Aja Ekapadaya Namah' 108 times daily, especially on the day ruled by Jupiter. The presiding deity is Aja Ekapada. This propitiation pacifies afflictions to the natal Moon/lagna when in this nakshatra and is prescribed for nakshatra shanti in BPHS Ch.94.
Chant Guru Ashtottara Shatanamavali 108 times on Thursdays. Jupiter (Guru) blesses with wisdom, wealth, and progeny when propitiated.

This propitiation pacifies afflictions to the natal Moon/lagna when in this nakshatra and is prescribed for nakshatra shanti in BPHS Ch.94.
